source.title: Operational Data List of Hydrogen Refueling Stations for Beijing Winter Olympics

intake_sequence: Record the custodian decision and written reuse terms before opening numerical cells.
Copy the received files into gitignored quarantine and compute SHA-256 digests byte-for-byte.
Verify the four expected file roles and retain the original source-file identifiers.
Freeze the model commit, engineering screens, eligible-case rule and holdout split.
Read the data dictionary and map aliases to the locked channel groups without fitting parameters.
Run the numerical evaluation once on untouched eligible fills; retain every failure and missing-channel case.
Publish only de-identified derived traces, file digests and case metrics allowed by the custodian.

promotion_rules.inventory_ready: All four file roles are present, each file has an immutable SHA-256, and the description/data dictionary is retained.
promotion_rules.eligible_for_channel_mapping: Inventory is ready and every required metadata item is declared with units, definitions or an explicit not-available value.
promotion_rules.eligible_for_full_loop_validation: Channel groups contain synchronized vehicle/receptacle pressure, temperature, mass/flow, initial conditions, capacity and protocol metadata for untouched fills, with written publication/reuse terms.
reject_primary_claim_if: Vehicle/receptacle pressure or transferred mass is absent.
The station and vehicle clocks cannot be aligned or the sampling rule is unknown.
The tank capacity or initial state is unavailable.
The protocol/pressure-ramp and stop/abort semantics cannot be identified.
Outcome values were used to tune the model or choose the holdout split.
Written terms do not permit derived metrics in the manuscript and repository.

claim_boundary: This protocol and any byte-level inventory prove acquisition integrity and prospective eligibility only. They are not numerical validation, safety certification, field-distance evidence, or proof of SAGA effectiveness. The IJHE/full-objective gate remains closed until an untouched numerical evaluation and independent effectiveness review are complete.
